# Manhatta

> Fine dining New American restaurant by Chef Michele Brogioni, located sixty stories above Lower Manhattan with panoramic NYC views.

Manhatta is part of Danny Meyer's Union Square Hospitality Group, offering prix-fixe menus, craft cocktails, and private event spaces at 28 Liberty Street's 60th floor in the Financial District.

## Key Topics

- New American cuisine
- Fine dining
- Chef Michele Brogioni
- Prix-fixe menu
- Craft cocktails
- Private events
- FiDi location
- 60th floor views
- Wine pairing
- Danny Meyer
- Rebecca Choi
- Upscale dining
- Manhattan skyline
- Small plates
- Lunch and dinner service
